chunks: My father (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, he said: Al-Husayn ibn Musa narrated to us from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar - and al-Husayn did not memorize the chain of narration - he said:
Luqman said to his son: O my son! Take one thousand friends for yourself, for one thousand is too few; and do not take even one enemy, for one is too many.

Then Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Increase in brethren as much as you can, for they are pillars and supporters when their help is sought. One thousand close friends and companions is not many, but indeed one enemy is too many.

key_terms.خل: Close friend, intimate companion - a poetic term for deep friendship
key_terms.صديق: Friend, close companion - from the root s-d-q (truthfulness), implying a sincere, truthful friend
key_terms.عماد: Pillar, support, backbone - used metaphorically for reliable friends who serve as structural support

ai.seo_question: What did Luqman and Imam Ali say about the importance of friendship in Islam?
ai.summary: This narration combines the wisdom of Luqman the Wise with poetry from Imam Ali (AS) on the supreme importance of cultivating friendships and avoiding enmity. Luqman, a legendary sage mentioned in Surah 31 of the Quran, advised his son to seek as many friends as possible since even a thousand is insufficient, while warning that even a single enemy is too many. Imam Ali then reinforced this teaching through verse, emphasizing that brothers and companions serve as pillars of support in times of need.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (ra) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Musa narrated to us from Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar. Al-Husayn did not memorize the isnad. He said:
Luqman said to his son: O son! Take one thousand friends for yourself, for one thousand is few; and do not take one enemy for yourself, for one is too many.
Amir al-Mu’minin (as) said:  Increase in brethren as much as you can, They are pillars and backs if you seek their help, One thousand friends and companions is not many, But one enemy is too many.
